Subject: Re: Request: Isolated VPC pilot credits + evidence gating

Hi Kenji — great to meet you yesterday.

Short answers up front:
- We typically provide a one-time pilot credit top-up equivalent to $8,000–$12,000 for a 3–6 week isolated VPC POC depending on expected token volume and whether you need dedicated nodes. We can scope more precisely after you confirm concurrent workload (we can start with $8k and top up if needed).
- Minimal artifacts to qualify for the isolated pilot credit:
  1) SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC2 letter of attestation)
  2) Network diagram showing VPC peering / private endpoints (redact IPs if needed)
  3) Data classification and retention policy for datasets used in the pilot
  4) A short runbook describing who will have access to the pilot environment and for what purpose
- Signing: Sales can approve and sign a standard POC MOU for credit top-ups under $15k. Anything above that requires legal review. If procurement confirms they want delegated signing we can have Dev or Jonas sign on behalf of Sales — please confirm internal PO thresholds.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Send the SOC2 + network diagram to security@redwood.com and cc me.
2) If those are in order, I will author a POC MOU and push a DocuSign for signature (sales-delegated for up to $15k).
3) We’ll provision the isolated environment and apply the credit; credits expire 90 days from issuance.

Looping in Dev and Monica to confirm delegated approval path and to prepare the mutual action plan (MAP).

— Rishi
